name: georgian-games
description: Production multiplayer Georgian classics gaming platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @georgian-games/web" "npm run dev -w @georgian-games/game-server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @georgian-games/shared && npm run build -w @georgian-games/game-server && npm run build -w @georgian-games/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @georgian-games/shared && npm run test -w @georgian-games/game-server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @georgian-games/shared --if-present && npm run lint -w @georgian-games/game-server --if-present && npm run lint -w @georgian-games/web --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @georgian-games/shared && npm run typecheck -w @georgian-games/game-server && npm run typecheck -w @georgian-games/web --if-present
